name: ai-architecture-integrity-study
description: MSc dissertation research on architectural integrity in LLM-generated code (WMG, University of Warwick)
author: Wei Luo

scripts.install:all: pnpm install && cd experiment && [ -f requirements.txt ] && python -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt || echo 'No Python deps to install'
scripts.test:baseline: pnpm --filter backend test && pnpm --filter crm-baseline-frontend --if-present test
scripts.lint:baseline: pnpm --filter backend lint && pnpm --filter crm-baseline-frontend --if-present lint
